meta.title: Gateway — KB Labs
meta.description: Single entry point. Any service gets LLM, EventBus, Cache, and Storage over HTTP — no vendor lock-in.

gateway.telemetryTitle: Events from any service. No schema.
gateway.ctaDescription: Providers swap in config — services stay untouched. Gateway starts with the platform.
gateway.aiLead: The model field is a tier (small · medium · large), not a model name. The LLM Router resolves the tier to a concrete adapter. Swap the provider in config — all calls pick it up automatically.
gateway.telemetryLead: POST /telemetry/v1/ingest — up to 500 events per batch, dot-notation types, free-form payload. Writes to IAnalytics — SQLite, DuckDB, or file.
gateway.platformLead: POST /platform/v1/:adapter/:method — nine adapters with a clear method allowlist. Streaming automatic when the method returns AsyncIterable.
gateway.heroDescription: Any HTTP service gets LLM, EventBus, Cache, and Storage through a single endpoint. Providers swap in config — consumers stay untouched.
gateway.adapterDiagramCaption: the contract defines the interface · the adapter implements it
